about: Flag-off golden for test/flagoff.test.mjs (txv1 design U4): per case, the calls and their outcomes, the paymaster requests, the JSON-RPC requests in order and the portal pages opened, as test/support/flagoff.mjs compacts them.
recordedFrom: @lazorkit/wallet 3.4.0: dist/index.mjs of the published release tarball (sha1 3cf61c6e694f6b4a7fd0c9bbe80c4fe627c153dc, the registry's dist.shasum), run with this workspace's dependencies. Case for case equal to the 3.3.1 golden it replaces (sha1 08d97bd0...), itself as 3.3.0's (sha1 14ba54ab...), and, uncompacted (every request in full), to this branch's build at fd9592c but for the minified names of 17 error constructors. Against 3.2.1 (sha1 a0b86a78...), the 8 session cases make one more call first, getSlot (#110 deletes an expired session's kept key before it signs); everything else is identical.
